messages:
maya: quick heads up — in the v2p3-int4 canary for billing-invoices cohort we see +3.8% delta on extract_fidelity vs prod v2. holdout N=4500, bootstrap 95% CI ±0.9%, p<0.01. our auto-fallback is set to 2.5%. do we want immediate rollback or a short hold? :warning:
jordan: can you paste the holdout breakdown (slice sizes + CI) and the raw A/B numbers?
maya: sure — short summary below:
```json
{
  "cohort": "billing-invoices",
  "canary_n": 4500,
  "prod_n": 4600,
  "delta_extract_fidelity": 0.038,
  "ci_95": 0.009,
  "p_value": 0.003
}
```
li: is this visible in the nightly shadow compare? iirc shadow showed ~1.6% gap but with way smaller sample (5% traffic). could be sampling noise.
maya: yeah shadow run from 03:00 had smaller sample and the slice there was underrepresented — canary got more realistic distribution (50% for that cohort).
zach: @ops-bot can you surface the last 12h anomaly alerts for that cohort and check infra differences (KV cache warmup, batch size)?
ops-bot: fetched alerts: 3 anomalies in last 12h for billing-invoices slice; kv_cache_miss_rate bumped from 2.1% -> 4.8% on quant nodes. attached logs: /s3/redwood/canary/logs/1714209_canary_kv.log
sasha: proposal: hold traffic for 30m, run targeted synthetic eval (10k samples) and a KV-cache warmup run. if synthetic delta > 2.0% we auto-revert. also try a lightweight "sanitizer" before decoding to strip trailing invoice-number tokens — we've seen parse mismatches from quant rounding. example quick regex to try:
```bash
# quick sanitizer to remove trailing invoice noise
sed -E 's/\s+Invoice#\d+$//i' < input.txt > sanitized.txt
```
eva: +1 to hold. also double-check tokenization parity between FP and quantized kernels — sometimes quantized embedding quantization shifts leads to off-by-one tokenization that breaks exact-match metrics.
maya: ok running synthetic eval now + kv warmup. starting with 10k seeded inputs (same seed set as last onboarding). will post results in ~20m. if result crosses the auto-fallback rule, can we let the rollout system trigger rollback automatically? @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: auto-fallback rule currently configured: condition = (delta_extract_fidelity >= 0.025) AND (p_value < 0.05) -> trigger rollback to v2 (fallback target pinned). Manual overrides allowed by @engineering-sig. Will queue rollback if orchestrator sees the condition true in the canary window.
zach: documenting: if rollback happens, ops-team runbook: 1) pin traffic, 2) run kv-cache full-warmup job, 3) spin up fp-bridge for 30m to compare outputs, 4) open postmortem ticket.
maya: thanks — posting eval output shortly. if anyone wants to join the quick call, I'll be in #eng-ml-calls. :phone:
